verdict.rationale: The README's Getting Started section lists separate install paths for Claude Code, Antigravity, Codex App/CLI, Cursor, Devin CLI, Factory Droid, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and OpenCode, and states that installation differs by harness. Release notes add Devin, Hermes, Grok and an Antigravity manifest, and the porting guide says `skills/` is shared verbatim across every harness, with only a tool-mapping and bootstrap layer added per harness. Evals run the skills in real Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI sessions. A community user confirms the per-harness install route for Codex/OpenCode, and a runtime probe installed a skill into Claude Code. Missing for 10: hands-on install corroboration beyond Claude Code, and detailed Cursor-specific instruction content in the evidence.
